svg.aria-label: The Quire repositories. The main chain runs from the standard, quire-specification, to the compiler, quire-spec-language, then quire-contract-ir, quire-contract-codegen and quire-contract-runtime. quire-spec-language also feeds quire-protocol, and quire-contract-ir feeds quire-analyze. quire-observation feeds quire-protocol and quire-mltl. Above the chain, quire-driver runs it, quire-integration tests it and quire-verification plans verification. Below it, shared libraries used throughout: quire-exact, quire-semantic-value, quire-walk, quire-canonical and quire-verification-contracts.
